lines.t: In the land of sorrow, where the fields ran dry,
Ruth stood beside Naomi, with a tear in her eye.
The road looked empty, the journey unknown,
But love spoke louder than fear ever shown.
Wherever you go, I will go too,
Your people my people, your God my truth.
Through harvest and heartache, through night and through sun,
The story of grace has only begun.
In Bethlehem's fields, under God’s open sky,
She gleaned in the shadows where mercy passed by.
Boaz saw her courage, her faith shining through,
A promise of blessing in all she would do.
Wherever you go, I will go too,
Your people my people, your God my truth.
Through harvest and heartache, through night and through sun,
The story of grace has only begun.
From ashes to hope, from loss to divine,
Redemption was written in heaven’s design.
From Ruth came a lineage, a King and a Lamb,
Proof that love’s power is God’s perfect plan.
Wherever You lead, I will follow still,
Through every valley, I’ll trust Your will.
For out of the broken, You made something new,
The same grace that found Ruth is calling me too.
